# Retainbee by PickMyWork

> Retainbee is a customer engagement platform for D2C brands. It brings leads from stores, campaigns, CSV files and field teams into one profile each, then re-engages and converts them into repeat customers on WhatsApp, SMS, email, RCS and push. Built by PickMyWork.

## Main page
- [Retainbee by PickMyWork](https://www.pickmywork.com/retainbee/): what the platform does, how leads become repeat customers, the two product films and FAQs.

## What Retainbee does
- One profile for every lead, tagged by source and city.
- Lead sources: store orders, email, SMS and RCS campaigns, CSV imports, and PickMyWork field teams (optional).
- Channels: email, WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, push notifications and in-app messages, from one journey builder.
- Integrations: Shopify, WooCommerce, Razorpay, Google Sheets, Claude and ChatGPT.
- Reporting on what each message earned.

## Field teams (optional lead source)
Trained PickMyWork field teams run product trials, in-store demos, society, gym and college drives and launch activations. Each conversation is logged on the PickMyWork Field App with a GPS stamp and a photo, with consent, and the lead goes straight into Retainbee.

## About PickMyWork
- [PickMyWork](https://www.pickmywork.com/): the company behind Retainbee and its field teams.
